_comment: object_ground — pure visual-grounding probe. The harness spawns one tinted sphere per entry in `balls` at the listed world coord (each ball deliberately landing on / next to a real apartment object whose alias is in `alias`). The agent sees the screenshot + the `candidate_aliases` list (with each candidate's listed world coord) and must reply with a `{color: alias}` mapping. Verifier scores percentage of correct matches.

scene_start_pose._view: fallback if a task doesn't specify camera_start_pose

match_4_utensils_pot_view.description: Match colored balls to the four kitchen utensils (wooden spatula, wooden spoon, black spatula, black spoon) — pot-area camera looking down at the utensil row.

camera_start_pose._view: default pot view from photoreal_grounding/object_grounding/(see groundtruth) — pawn at (393.7, -456.5, 214.4) yaw 89.7, pitch -48

match_4_utensils_cutting_view.description: Same four utensils, viewed from the cutting-board side instead of the pot side.

camera_start_pose._view: default cutting-board view — pawn south-east of cutting board

match_2_cookware_cooktop_view.description: Match colored balls to the saucepan and the pot — cooktop default view from south.

match_6_kitchen_cooktop_view.description: Hardest case: 6 differently-colored balls on pan, pot, and 4 utensils — agent must distinguish all six from a single cooktop view.

find_knife_cutting_view.description: the kitchen knife on the cutting board (long thin metal blade with handle)

random_view._note: Cutting board sits in the NW corner of the kitchen — overhead cabinets above (Z~180-220) and walls on the -Y / -X sides. The default prior pose at cam_y=-489 looks SOUTH from inside that alcove, and ±5° jitter still lands in cabinets. For random-view runs we flip to the OPEN living-room side: cam at +Y of the target, looking back NORTH (yaw≈270°). Explicit yaw/pitch ranges bypass the prior-jitter mechanism so we ignore camera_start_pose entirely. Distance 140-170 + pitch -30..-20 keeps cam_y around -198..-225 (well in front of the counter, no walls) and cam_z around 150-170. Aim offset 15-25 cm randomizes the centre off the target.
